TypeScript Component

Virtual Keyboard

A fully customizable on-screen virtual keyboard with multiple layout modes. Perfect for touch interfaces, kiosk applications, and accessibility features.

Interactive Demo

Click or tap the keys to type. Switch between different keyboard modes.

Features

⌨️ Multiple Layouts

Default, shift, and special character modes with easy switching.

📱 Touch Optimized

Large touch targets and responsive design for mobile devices.

🎨 Customizable

Define your own keyboard layouts and key mappings.

⚡ Event Callbacks

Hook into key press events for custom functionality.

Usage

Basic Usage

import { VirtualKeyboard } from 'move.gl'; // Create a virtual keyboard const keyboard = new VirtualKeyboard('textInput', 'keyboard'); // Switch to different modes keyboard.switchMode('shift'); // Uppercase letters keyboard.switchMode('special'); // Special characters keyboard.switchMode('default'); // Lowercase letters // Clean up when done keyboard.destroy();

HTML Structure

<!-- Input element --> <input type="text" id="textInput"> <!-- Keyboard container --> <div id="keyboard"></div>

Custom Layout

const customLayout = { "default": [ ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"], ["q", "w", "e", "r", "t"], ["a", "s", "d", "f", "g"], ["Backspace"] ], "shift": [ ["!", "@", "#", "$", "%"], ["Q", "W", "E", "R", "T"], ["A", "S", "D", "F", "G"], ["Backspace"] ] };

API Reference

Constructor

new VirtualKeyboard(inputId: string, keyboardId: string)

Methods

Method Description
switchMode(mode: string) Switch keyboard layout mode ('default', 'shift', 'special')
destroy() Remove event listeners and clean up

Built-in Modes

Mode Description
default Lowercase letters and numbers
shift Uppercase letters and symbols
special Special characters and punctuation
